title: Saving the gym's look never says how many members will actually see it
what: After saving a logo and colours, the owner is told new members see it at once and others on a later visit. Only members who have the member app and have joined the gym in it ever see the look, and the screen gives no count or list of who that is. At the test gym none of its 2 members are on the app, so the saved look reaches nobody while the message reads as if it reaches everyone.
expected: Next to Save, a line like 'Members on the app: 0 of 2 will see this' with a way to invite the rest.
fix_line: Show how many members are on the app and will see the new look

title: The long note after saving the gym's look disappears before it can be read
what: After Save, a 32-word note explains when members see the new look and that the app checks at most once an hour. It vanishes after 3 seconds, too short to read, and is not shown anywhere else on the screen afterwards.
expected: The explanation stays on screen (for example under the Saved label) or the short message stays long enough to read.
fix_line: Keep the when-members-see-it note on the screen after saving

items.reason: needs a real-phone check: save a new look, reopen the member app after an hour, look for the logo splash and new colours; no phone-maker or watch alert path exists here
